title: Report-based stopping criterion (conv-reports/add)
journal: /solve/convergence-conditions/conv-reports/add {{name}}-conv initial-values-to-ignore {{ignore}} print? yes report-defs "{{name}}" stop-criterion {{stop}} previous-values-to-consider {{window}} active? yes q q q
interactive: add → criterion name → initial-values-to-ignore → print? → report-defs (report name in quotes) → stop-criterion → previous-values-to-consider → active? → q q q
notes: DERIVED: the key order and the three `q` are taken from the verified journal. reportDef is the name of an already created report definition (report.definitions and conv-reports are linked by name in the journal). strict mode: ignore 50/stop 1e-3/window 1000/freq 100; relaxed mode: ignore 100/stop 5e-3/window 500/freq 50. The type/field/surfaces parameters are declared for compatibility with compile.js and are not used in the line.
